newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen refraining from open market operations.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen refraining from open market operations.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is expected to refrain from open market operations Friday, analysts said.
"Our call is for no Fed at all," said an economist at Stone and MaCarthy Research Associates Inc.
Analysts at consulting firm MMS International Inc expect the Fed to stay out of the market as well.
At 0910 EST/1410 GMT, the federal funds rate traded at 5-1/8 percent, below the Fed's 5-1/4 percent target.
